tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsang ba'i mgur rdo rje'i tshig rkang sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad gsang ba nyams len gyi mgur drug rje btsun chen po mi la bzhad pa rdo rjes/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gdams pa ni/ sngags kyi zab gnad mthar thug pa rim gnyis sogs bla med kyi lam gyi gnad mtha' dag rdzogs par ston pa/ brjod bya zab la rgya che zhing*/ brjod byed kyi tshig nyung la 'gag 'doms shin tu che ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gi mgur byin brlabs can/ thos pa tsam gyis bla med kyi lam mtha' dag la bag chags 'jog nus pa'i gsang ba nyams len gyi mgur drug gi don bshad pa la gsum/ mchod brjod/ rgyud snod rgyud du sgrub pa/ snod du rgyud nas lam la slob pa'o// dang po/ dpal mi skyod rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// pha rje btsun mar pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ snod rung dang po thun mong ba'i lam gyi rgyud sbyangs pa/ gnyis pa dbang bzhi thob dgos par bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum las/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam ni/ dus da lta mi la ras pa yis/ dal 'byor gyi phung po rnyed dka' zhing rnyed na don che ba 'di nges par myur du 'dor dgos la/ skye ba dang shi ba yi 'phrang la shar bab ya re nga bas sdug bsngal mang po myong zhing*/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song gsum gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gcong rong 'di g.yang sa la shin tu che bas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las thar nas mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phangs thob phyir du mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims la slob dgos par bstan no/ ༈ /gnyis pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam ni/ las rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel pa ma zad bar du spyir khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor nas sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul la bsams tsa na/ sdug bsngal de'i rtsa ba chos dang gang zag bdag 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa 'jig re dran pas te bdag 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i phyir du bdag med skye pa'i shes rab sgom dgos par bstan no/

༈ /gsum pa skyes bu chen po'i lam ni/ 'gro drug gi sems can rnams drin can gyi ma yin la mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul la bzod thabs med pa'i brtse ba chen po drangs pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems skyed nas/ sems can rnams kyi 'dren pa rgyal ba'i sku 'di myur du sgrub pa'i sngags bla med kyi lam gcig btsal la nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du bsam pa de bstan no/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbang bzhi thob dgos par bstan pa la bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ rim gnyis sgom pa'i dus kyi thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur la 'jug dgos ste des lus tha mal gyi dngos 'dzin lha skur 'jis pas de de lta bu'i dngos 'dzin dor nas/ lha'i rnam rol du 'char ba'i bskyed rims zab mo bsgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu sprul sku'i sa bon 'jogs phyir/ gnyis pa gsang dbang ni/ ngag rlung la gsang dbang bskur dgos ste/ de ltar bskur ba yis/ rlung ro rkyang gi rgyu ba dbu mar 'chad/ de zhugs gnas gsum byas pa las byung pa'i shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems las grub pa'i sgyu lus sogs snang phyogs kyi rdzogs rims sgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bus longs sku'i sa bon 'jogs pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ dbang gsum pa'i bde chen sbar ba yis sgo nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur dgos ste/ des lhan skyes kyi bde chen gyi/ dbyings bdag med kyi na chung gcer bur mngon gsum du mthong ba'i don gyi 'od gsal sogs stong phyogs kyi rdzogs rims bsgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu sprul sku'i sa bon 'jog phyir ro/ ༈ /bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ tshig brjod pa'i sgo nas zab pa don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ rgyas pa dag pa'i sgyu ma'i sku zung du 'jug pa'i sku bzhis zung 'jug de ngo sprad nas/ dbang bzhi pa sku gsum dbyer med zung 'jug gi snod rung de thob par byed dgos ste/

des zung 'jug gi rdzogs rims sgom pa la dbang zhing 'bras bu zung 'jug gi sku'i sa bon 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa snod du rung nas lam la bslab pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar thun mong ba'i lam skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs shing gsang sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang bzhi la zhugs pa de thob nas de'i rjes su lam rims pa gnyis bsgom pa la 'bad dgos ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas 'bras bu sku gsum gyi go 'phangs mngon du byas ste rang gzhan gyi don rdzogs par byed nus pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ skyed rims la bslab tshul dang rdzogs rim la bslab tshul lo// dang po la bzhi/ 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer/ bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer/ skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer/ sku gsum gyi sgrub gzhi rang chas su yod pas sgrub sla bar bstan pa'i phyir ro// dang po ni/ bskyed rims kyi lam gyi thog mar sgom pa nges don gyi lha'i sku/ lha chos kyi dbyings dang bde ba chen po'i ye shes dbyer med la snyoms par 'jug pa'i chos sku'i lam 'khyer sgom dgos ste/ des 'chi ba sbyong zhing*/ stong phyogs kyi rdzogs rims rnams smin byed bya ste chos sku 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni de lta bu'i chos kyi dbyings dang rig pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis las tshogs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i longs sku'i lam 'khyer sgom dgos ste/ des bar do sbyong zhing*/ snang phyogs kyi rdzogs rims kyi smin byed byas nas longs sku 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ don longs sku de las sprul sku shāka thub sogs pa lta bu'i sprul sku'i lam 'khyer sgom dgos ste des skye ba sbyong zhing*/ sgyu lus pas rags pa'i sprul sku 'dzin pa'i smin byed bya ste 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i phyir ro/

༈ /bzhi pa ni/ sku gsum gyis lam 'khyer 'di skye shi bar do 'joms byed yin pas na sku gsum nyid rang la rang chas su rnyed pas na/ 'bras bu nyid gzhan la re dogs dang bral ba'o// mi la rdo rje rgyan mtshan gyi skyed rims gyi glu*/ de rnams kyi don snying por dril na/ thun mong pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam la bslab pa'i 'og tu dbang bzhi rdzogs thob par byas nas/ khyad par du bskyed rims kyi gnad chos longs sprul gsum gyi lam 'khyer la slob tshul gsal bar bstan pa yin no// gsang ba nyams len gyi mgur drug las/ gsang ba bskyed rims kyi mgur dang po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams kyi don go bde bar legs par bkral zin to/ ༈ /gnyis pa rdzogs rims la slob tshul la bzhi/ dngos grub 'phran don du mi gnyer bar mchog sgrub dgos par bstan pa/ dngos grub thams cad kyi dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos par bstan pa/ rdzogs rims dngos chos drug yan lag dang bcas pa la slob tshul spyir bstan pa/ gtum mo dang sgyu lus sogs la slob tshul bye brag du bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mchod brjod dang*/ don de dngos bshad pa gnyis/ dang po/ ri khrod phyogs med du nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma shar pa'i mgur ni/ pha bde stong dbyer med kyi don bsgoms pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi bcings pa med par grol ba'i rje bde chen 'od gsal chos kyi sku yis go 'phangs brnyes pa'i pha 'bral ba med par bla ma dam pa snying la dus rtag tu bzhugs/ las mchog gi dngos grub brtsal du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rje btsun rang nyid dngos grub 'bring dang tha ma don du mi gnyer bar dngos grub mchog don du gnyer ba'i rin po che lta bu gdams ngag du bstan pa/ rje btsun ji lta ba bzhin du rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang dngos grub phran mi sgrub par tshe bstan gyi mdun ma mchog gi dngos grub sgrub dgos par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/

dus da lta mi la ras pa nga*// gangs ti se'i mgul na sgom tsa na// bde stong gi ye shes kyi mdangs kyi cha la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ngang nas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa shar bas na spyan dang mngon shes sogs 'dod na 'ong tshod du gda' ste phran de rnams don du mi gnyer bar mi la ras pa nga mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la rtse cig tu sems pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig lags so// nga chu bar brag dmar 'chong lding na/ sgom tsa na nam mkha' la lhung ba med par 'phur 'gro nus pa byung bas rdzu 'phrul sogs 'dod na 'ong tshod gda'/ nga mchog la sems pa'i rnal 'byor lags// nga tshe ring gangs dkar stong shed na// srid gsum gyi 'dre la ya mi nga*// bar mi 'jigs pa thob pas dbang bsdud sogs 'dod na 'ongs tshod gda'// nga mchog la sems pa'i rnal 'byor lags// nga la phyi gangs la sgom tsa na/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs pas na/ thun mong gi dngos grub gcig 'dod na 'ongs tshod gda'/ nga mchog la sems pa'i rnal 'byor lags// gnyis pa ni/ kho bos mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i phyir du/ 'phongs rul nas rma chen po gyur pa 'di ltar du song song sgoms pa las mchog gi dngos grub byung ba yin pas/ bu ras chung pa dngos grub thun mong pa don du ma gnyer bar mchog gi dngos grub sgrub phyir du lus la dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas brtson pa chen po bskyed dgos pa 'di'i don yid la bsam na legs/ rang snying la mchog sgrub pa'i gros chen btab na legs pas gros btab pa'i sgo nas brtson pa drag pos bskul lcags byas ste rang gzhan thams cad kyi tshe gtan gyi 'dun ma mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la brtson par gyis shig pa'o// mi la rdo rje rgyan mtshan gyi nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma shar ba'i mgur : de rnams kyi don snying por dril na/ bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin rjes dngos grub phran mi sgrub par/

mchog gi dngos grub brtson pa drag pos sgrub dgos par bstan pa yin no// gsang ba nyams len gyi mgur drug las gsang ba'i nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma phyogs med du shar ba'i mgur gnyis po'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams kyi don go bde bar legs par bkral zin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos par bstan pa la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ don de dngos su bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu'i mgur ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde stong gi ngang du dbyer med kyi don gzigs kyang*/ tha snyad du dkar nag gi las 'bras dang sbyin pa btang ba dang ma btang ba'i rgyu las 'bras bu longs spyod kyi 'byor pa che ba dang chung ba'i rgyud 'byung ba'i las rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba'i gnas tshul gzigs nas/ don dam par chos rnams rang bzhin gyi stong zhing tha snyad du las 'bras phra zhing phra ba'i rnam bzhag 'thad pa 'di rang nyid kyis gzigs pa bzhin du zhal nas gzhan gdul bya rnams la gdams pa yis/ pha 'gro ba'i mig su mar pa lo tsā ba/ bka' drin 'khor med gtso ba'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud do zhes pa'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ dam tshig bsrung tshul spyir bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa/ ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs bsrungs pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa ni dgos 'dod thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin pas rin po che dang 'dra ba/ de tshul bzhin du bsrungs ba la 'bad par gyis shig ces gdams pa yin no// dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba de mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bla ma rten pa'i dam tshig dang yi dam sgom pa'i dam tshig rdo rje spun la dag snang sbyong ba'i dam tshig sems can la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i dam tshig dang bu med la gus pa bskyed pa'i dam tshig gza' ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba'i dam tshig de la sogs pa'i dam tshig 'di rnams tshul bzhin bsrung ba 'di dam tshig mchog gi nor bu yin te de tshul bzhin du bsrungs pa las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir ro/

༈ /gnyis pa la brgyad yod pa las dang po bla ma brten pa'i dam tshig ni/ gsum ldan sogs chos 'brel nod pa'i rje bla ma de sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi skur mos la bla ma de yis gsung skyon rjod thams cad dang bral ba'i chos ston pas yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs shes pa'i sgo nas bla mas ci gsung thams cad dang du blang zhing sgrub par bya ba ni bla ma'i thugs thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i nyi ma phyogs med du shar bas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin pa las sku gsung thugs dang yon tan gyi mdzad pa la dad gus chen po sgom par bya'o// bla ma des/ bu lon gtong len dang zhing las mdzad pa dang mngon spyod sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan tshar bcad rjes bzung gi mdzad pa sogs spyir gang mdzad yon tan du shes pa dang*/ dgos sangs rgyas kyi phrin las su mthong ba'i dad gus byung na/ gang zag de lam bzang sgrub pa'i gdul bya mchog yin pas bla ma la dad gus sgom pa ni sngags kyi lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam pa yin pas skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod kyis bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la skyon 'dogs kyi blo bkag nas/ yon tan mtha' yas pas mnga' tshul bsam nas dad gus sgom pa kho na dge sbyor gyi mthil du bzung bar bya ba yin no// de dag gi rtsa ltung dang po gsum ldan gyi bla ma la brnyas smod spangs nas/ bla mas ci mdzad yon tan dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su mthong ba'i dad gus sgom pa dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa bar bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa yi dam sgom pa'i dam tshig ni/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu bstan pa'i he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis yul gshegs pa dang sems mas rgyas btab pa'i sgo nas/ gang snang lha skur bsgom zhing 'dug gnas dang zas gos la sogs pa'i/ gang snang lhan skyes kyi bde stong gi rol par dus rtag tu 'char yang 'tshal te gang snang bde stong gi rnam rol du 'char ba la bslab dgos par bstan/

'dis phyag rgya'i dam tshig bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa rdo rje spun la dag snang sbyong ba'i dam tshig ni/ rje bla ma gcig gi dbang bskur ba'i bde stong gi thabs shes las byung ba'i mched lcam rdo rje spun sogs la khros pa spangs nas dag snang sbyongs dgos pa ni gal shin tu che ba'o// 'dis rtsa ltung gnyis pa rdo rje spun la khros pa spangs nas dag snang sbyong dgos par bstan no/ ༈ /bzhi pa sems can la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i dam tshig ni/ spyir 'gro ba sems can 'di kun bdag gi ma yin zhing ma 'di rnams ma rig gi ling tog gi dbang gis mig long zhing de'i dbang gis chags sogs nyon mongs pa rnams bskyed/ de'i dbang gis sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba 'di la bzod thabs 'dug ge rnal 'byor pa ste sems can sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi rtse ba dang*/ bde ba dang 'phrad 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal sgral phyir du/ sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ rtsa ltung bzhi pa dang lnga pa bsrung tshul bstan/ rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams da 'gro ba'i don du bsngo yang 'tshal te dus gsum du bsngo ba byed pa yang gal che bar ston no// des mdor na rtsa ltung bzhi pa dang lnga pa bsrung tshul sems can la byams snying rje'i sgo nas byang chub du sems bskyed de dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo dgos par bstan no/ ༈ /lnga pa bud med la gus pa bskyed pa'i dam tshig ni shes rab kyi ni bud med 'di/ lhan skyes kyi bde chen dang sgyu ma'i sku sgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu/ yin pas spyir dman par nam yang mi blta zhing*/ de la smod pa spangs nas dgos rdo rje phag mor ltas la gsol ba btab cing phyag dang skor ba byas par mos par bya'o// 'dis rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa shes rab kyi rang bzhin bud med la smod pa spongs nas/

lhan skyes dang sgyu lus kyi sgrub gzhir shes pa'i sgo nas lha'i skur bltas te phyag dang skor ba bya dgos par bstan no/ ༈ /drug pa bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ rang lha rgyal ba rigs drug gi rnal 'byor gyis nga rgyal shin tu brtan pas bde stong gi ye shes rgyas pa'i phyir du lha mchod pa'i bsam pas/ 'dod yon spyi dang khyad par la rol cing longs spyad la zas gos gnas mal la sogs la longs spyod pa'i tshe lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bde stong gi rnam rol du longs spyod dgos kyis phal pas lha mi mchod pa ste zas gos sogs tha mal du longs mi spyad par bde stong gis zin pa'i sgo nas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod dgos pa yin no// de ltar longs spyod pa de phrang po'i 'dod yon gyi me rag mchod pa yin/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod sogs rdzas byin brlabs can tha mal du longs spyad na/ de seng ge'i zho snod ngan du blug pa dang 'dra ba yin/ de dag longs spyod pa na bde stong gis zin cing lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod dgos pa yin no// de dag gi lha'i rnal 'byor shin tu brtan pas 'dod yon spyi dang khyad par la longs spyod pa'i tshe lha mchod pa'i dgos kyis/ tha mal du longs spyod na nyes dmigs che bar bstan no/ ༈ /bdun pa mi 'bral zhing bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ mi 'bral zhing bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ rus rgyan rdo dril sogs mi 'bral bar/ btsangs zhing mdor na/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bsam/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang sbom po brgyad la sogs pa'i/ rtsa ba dang yan lag 'khor bcas bsrungs/ 'dis rdor dril sogs dang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bsrungs tshul dang*/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang*/ sbom po brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa bsrungs tshul bstan no/ ༈ /brgyad pa snod min la gsang bar gdams pa'i dam tshig ni/ dbang ma bskur ba sogs la khyad par du ma rgyud yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa gsang zhing snying por rgyud dang chen po sangs rgyas thod pa gdan bzhi gsum sogs gsang zhing*/

yang snying rdo rje phag mo gsang la khyad par du snyan rgyud yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsum gsang zhing*/ pha rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i gsang 'dus gsang ma rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rjer gsang zhing yi dam gang yin gyi lha dang sngags phyag rgya yang gsang la dbang bzhi dang dbang thob bla ma dang rim gnyis sogs kyi gdams ngag gsang bar bya ba ni shin tu gal che ba yin no// de dag gi rtsa ltung bdun pa snod min la gsang bar gdams cing*/ snod ldan la snod la ltos te gsang sngags zab mo'i chos rnams legs par bshad dgos pa bstan no/ ༈ /gsum pa ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig 'di rnams ma bsrungs na 'jig par byed pa ste rdo rje dmyal ba sogs su bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal drag po myong dgos pa yin pas dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung ba gal shin tu che ba yin no/ ༈ /bzhi pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon ni/ dam tshig 'di bsrungs na dngos grub thams cad 'grub pa yin pas srog bdos bya ste dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba la 'bad par bya'o// mi la rdo rje rgyan mtshan gyi dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu'i glu*/ de rnams kyi don snying por dril na bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin rjes mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pas dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams srog bdos byas te tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos par bstan no// gsang ba nyams len gyi mgur drug las/ gsang ba'i dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu'i mgur gsum pa'i rdo rje tshig rkang rnams kyi don go bde bar legs par bkral zin to/ ༈ /gsum pa rdzogs rims dngos chos drug yan lag dang bcas pa la slob tshul spyir bstan pa la gsum/ mchod brjod yid bzhin nor bu gsum bshad pa/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ zab gnas mthar thug pa rims gnyis sogs bla med kyi lam mtha' dag rdzogs par ston pa/

brjod bya rgya che zhing*/ brjod byed tshig nyung la lam gyi gnad la 'gag 'doms shin tu che ba'i rdo rje'i tshig gi mgur byin brlabs can/ thos pa tsam gyis bla med kyi lam mtha' dag la bag chags 'jogs nus pa'i/ yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum dang mchog drug gi mgur ni/ pha stong pa bde chen te bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i mi slob pa'i zung 'jug lha'i sku'i/ ngo bor gyur pa'i rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ ༈ gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu/ smin lam yid bzhin nor bu/ dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gi sems stong pa bde ba'i dbyings su bzhugs pa de thugs bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa las mi g.yo ba'i ngos nas mgur 'di gsungs pa'o// pha mi la ras pa nga'i rgyud pa la gdeng tshad che ba yin te/ rgyud pa la gdeng tshad mi che rgyu/ byin brlabs kyi chu bo rgyun ma chad pa'i rgyud rdo rje 'chang chen/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo nā ro la sogs pa'i ste rje mar pas bdag la gnang ba'i man ngag gi rgyud pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas na yid bzhin nor bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor nga'i dbang la gdeng tshad che ba yin te nga dbang la gdeng tshad mi che rgyu/ bskyed rims kyis rgyud smin rjes su grol byed rdzogs rims kyi snod du rung zhing 'bras bu'i dbang gsum mam/ yang na 'bras bu sku gsum gyi sa bon 'jogs pa'i dbang gong ma gsum dang*/ smin byed kyi lam gyi snod rung sogs nor bu'i dbang drug yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ gsum pa ni/ pha nga'i dam tshig la gdeng tshad che ba yin te/ dam tshig la gdeng tshad mi che rgyu phyi so thar byang sems kyi sdom pa gnyis dang nang gsang sngags gyi sdom gsum tshul bzhin du bsrungs na dgos 'dod thams cad gter bas gdeng tshad che/ de rang gi sems skad cig ma gcig gi steng du lag len 'gril pas ste sdom gsum nyams len 'gal med yar ldan du nyams su blangs pa'i phyir ro// sho lo ka gsum pa des ni/

bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo la gnad du bsnun nas sku gsum gyi go 'phang thob pa la byin brlabs thams cad kyi rtsa ba rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar ma chad par dang por gnad che zhing*/ de nas bla ma de la sku bzhi'i sa bon thob nges kyi dbang bzhi rnam dag thob pa/ bar du gnad che la/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba ni/ tha mar gnad che bar bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa la smin byed bskyed rims bshad pa/ grol byed rdzogs rims chos drug dngos bshad pa/ snod ldan gyi gdul bya la gdams pa bka' rgyas btab pa'o// dang po ni/ rin po che lta bu'i sngags kyi snod ldan gyi gdul bya des/ dang por rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du dbang rgyud byin brlabs kyi chu bo'i rgyun ma chad pa'i dbang bzhi mtshan nyid tshang ba rdzogs par thob/ der rjes sdom pa gsum gyi bsrung sdom la 'bad pa'i ngang nas rang lus gshegs sems sogs lha'i sku dang*/ gang snang thams cad lha skur 'char ba dang*/ de yang bde stong gi rnam rol du lta ba'i chos longs sprul gsum gyi lam khyer gyis/ skye shi bar do gsum mngon 'gyur ba sbyongs nus pa'i bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin par bsgom dgos par bstan pa ni rje btsun rang nyid la/ spyir snang ba thams cad lha skur shar zhing dgos mi la ras pa nga yi phung po sogs lus he ru ka'i sku'i rang bzhin du shar ba yin zhing sems bde stong gi dbyings su thim nas slar yang lha'i skur ldang ba'i bskyed rims pa'i chos longs sprul gsum gyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa skye shi bar do la 'jigs nyams med pa ste gsum la mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng thob pa bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin zhes pa'i don yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin pa des pha ma'i rgyud sde gnyis kyi rdzogs rims kyi lam gyi gnad thams cad phyogs gcig tu sdoms pa'i chos drug ste/

de yang rdzogs rims zab mo'i lam thams cad kyi rmangs rdo mchog tu gyur pa gtum mo'i rnal 'byor rnams dang rdzogs rims kyi lam gyi ngo bo dpe'i don gyi 'od gsal las byung pa'i dag ma dag gi sgyu lus dngos dang*/ rjes mthun pa rnams dang*/ de las 'phros pa rmis lam sgyu ma dang*/ des don gyi 'od gsal dang lam gyi yan lag 'pho ba sogs/ grong 'jug bar do te nā ro'i chos drug dang nā ro'i khyad chos bsre ba bskor dgu ro snyoms dang bcas pa'i gnad/ khyad par can rgyud sde gnyis snying po rdzogs rims gyi lam zab mo nā ro pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa 'di ni snod ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyis snyigs dus kyi tshe thung la sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i nye lam khyad par can du rtogs nas/ phyi nang gi g.yeng ba thams cad spangs te/ lam 'di la sgrub pa snying por byed pa ni snod dam par shes par gyis ces pa'i don yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi zab gnad khyad par can 'di rnams khyod ras chung pa la gdams pa yin pas bu khyod kyis kyang gdams ngag 'di snying la chongs la khar ma 'don par rang nyid kyis gces par zung la nyams len mthar phyin par gyis/ gdam ngag 'di khyod min snod mi rung*/ gzhan la bka' rgyas btab nas snod mi rung ba la gsang nas nyams su len pa gal che ba yin no// mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mchog drug gi glu*/ de rnams kyi don dril na rin po che lta bu gang zag des rgyud pa'i chu bo ma nub pa'i dbang dang*/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i ngang nas lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis sgom dgos par bstan pa yin pas/ 'dis ni rgyud sde thams cad kyi brjod bya bsdus na rims gnyis yan lag dang bcas par 'du zhing*/ de dag kyang rdo rje'i tshig 'dis gsal bar bstan pas/ chos ngo tshar rmad du byung ba'i mgur bskyed rdzogs kyi lam gyi gnad zab mo blta shes pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnams yid phrog pa zhig du snang ngo*// rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa ston pa chos drug gi mgur rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don legs par bkral zin to/

༈ /bzhi pa sgyu lus dang gtum mo sogs la slob tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ rdzogs rims kyi bde stong 'dren byed kyi thabs gtum mo dang rdor bzlas sogs bshad pa/ rdzogs rims pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bsgom pa las byung pa'i sgyu lus dang bsre ba sogs bshad pa'o// dang po la drug mchod par brjod pa/ thabs lam gyi che ba bstan pa spyir thabs lam gyi rmangs rdo gtum mo bshad pa/ srog rtsol gyi rgyal po rdo rjer bzlas bshad pa/ de gnyis kyi mthus drangs pa'i stong phyogs 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rims bshad pa/ ches zab pa'i gnas 'di snod ldan la gdams shing bka' rgyas btab pa'o// mchog drug gi mgur du chos drug gi rkang drangs tsam bstan nas de rgyas par 'chad byed kyi mgur la yod pa las/ thog mar gtum mo'i mgur ni thabs lam dang thun mong par bstod pa ni/ pha rje btsun sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// rje rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad bsgoms pas// nyams rtogs kyi nyi ma kun khyab shar// rje gsang sngags rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// ces pas bstan te don rtogs sla'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir sngags kyi thabs lam zab mo bsgoms pa la brten nas tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub pas/ thabs lam de mchog 'grub pa'i gsang sngags kyi nye lam yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa ni spyir thabs lam de la phyi'i rkyen phyag rgya dang*/ nang gi rkyen phra mo dang mi shig pa dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ rdor bzlas dang*/ bum pa can sogs du ma yod pa las/ ma rgyud kyi thabs lam gyi gtso bo gtum mo'i sgom tshul ni/ dgos rdo rje phag mo lta ba'i mig ste bde drod myur du skye ba'i ched du man ngag gis rang phag mor bsgoms pa'i steng spyi bo'i dbu mar haṃ yig 'og lte ba'i dbu mar a thung bar snying kha dang mgrin pa'i dbu ma'i nang du rims bzhin hūm̐ dang aṃ te steng 'og bar gsum gyi gtum mo dang*/

yi ge de rnams las me 'bar bas rang lus mes gang bar sgom pa me rkyang gi gtum mo dang de las me cher 'bar bas brgyan stug po bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams mes gang ba sogs kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phyi nyi ma'i 'khor yug nang nas shar te phyi rol gyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i nyi ma'i dal grangs med pa rang lus la thim pas me cher 'bar te bde drod khyad par can skyes par bsam pa ni bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa khyad par yin no// 'dis ni rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs rnal 'byor mar rgyud kyi gtso bor bstan pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul gyi gnad ches shin tu zab cing gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /bzhi pa ni/ pha rgyud rdo rje phreng ba sogs nas bshad pa ltar rlung dbu mar 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rang gdangs yi ge gsum gyi gdangs su shar ba'i rdor bzlas kyis/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyis dbu ma bkris pa'i mdud pa rang sar grol bar byed pas sngags rdo rje bzlas pa ma rtogs pa/ yid sngags rnams gzhan la blo mi 'gel// zhes pa ste/ ngag bzlas sogs kyi sgo nas sngags gzhan gyi bzla ba rlung sngags dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdor bzlas nyid/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug du bsgom dgos pa yin te/ sngags gzhan thams cad bzlas pa'i phan yon dang*/ nus mthu rnams rdor bzlas byas pas 'grub pa'i phyir ro// 'dis ni rlung dbu mar 'dzud pa'i thabs phar rgyud gtso bor bstan pa rdor bzlas kyi gnad ches gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /lnga pa ni/ rlung 'jam pa dbu ma nas rgyu ba'i rlung dang rlung rtsub pa ro rkyang nas rgyu ba'i rlung gnyis ste rnal 'byor snying sprul nas te rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs de rnams bsgoms pas/ srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba dbu mar 'ching bas te rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las mig tu du ba/ mkha' snang*/

mar me/ snang mched thob gsum sprin med kyi nam mkha' lta bu'i 'od gsal rnams nyams su che bas te 'char la de ltar shar ba'i phyir stong pa bzhi dang*/ khyad par 'od gsal shar ba'i dus su rtsa dbu ma'i nang du khams dkar dmar gyi 'du 'phrod snying kha'i dbu ma nang gi dpyid kyi hūm̐ yig la 'du/ de la rten nas nyams bde drod sems la rtogs pa 'char te/ de dbu mar khams dkar dmar gyi 'bar 'dzag byas pa las dga' bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bde stong gi ye shes phul du byung ba 'char zhing*/ de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog dgos pa yin no 'dis ni pha ma'i rgyud sde gnyis kyi lam gyi snying po bde stong gi ye shes dang*/ stong phyogs 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rims gtso bor ston pa yin no/ ༈ /drug pa ni/ don 'di rnams bu yid la zung la sgom sran tshugs/ shin tu gces pa'i rdzogs rims kyi gnad 'di tshig tu min pa gzhan ma spel/ ces pa ni snod min la gsang ba'o/ de rnams kyis don dril na/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas bsgrod pa'i nye lam gsang sngags kyi bskyed rims phra rags mthar phyin rjes/ rlung dbu mar 'dzud pa'i thabs gtum mo dang*/ rdor bzlas kyi gnad dang rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las byung ba'i bde stong gi ye shes lam gyi snying por bstan pa yin no// gtum mo'i yig chung mi la rdo rje rgyan mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// don legs par bshad do/ ༈ /gnyis pa rdzogs rims pa'i bde stong gi ye shes bsgom pa las byung ba'i sgyu lus dang bsre ba sogs bshad pa la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa/ lam 'di gces par bzung bar gdams pa/ lam dngos bshad pa/ de'i che ba brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ pha rgyud thams cad kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo sgyu lus rmi lam gyi mgur ni/ dpal khyab bdag chen po he ru ka /yum rdo rje phag mos mgul nas 'khyud// dbyings bde ba mchog la rol mdzad pa'i// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'dis ni rgyu lus zung 'jug dang mthun par bla ma la bstod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

shin tu zab pa'i gnad tshe 'dir sangs rgya ba la med du mi rung ba bla ma'i zhal 'ba' zhig las shes par bya ba'i sgyu lus kyi man ngag khyad par can 'di/ bu mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa rdo rje grags pa khyod la bstan gyis snying la 'di ltar bsam na legs/ zhes pas te snying la gces par zung shig ces gdams pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa la gnyis*/ sgyu lus bshad pa dang*/ bsre ba bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sgyu lus spyir bstan pa/ sbas don gyi sgyu lus bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po spyir rang bzhin gyis grub par snang yang rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i za zi'i sgyu ma phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong pa'i snang ba sgyu ma dang*/ blos byas lha sku bde stong sgyu ma lta bar bsgom par bskyed rims pa dang thong pa'i sgyu ma dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems las grub pa'i rdzogs rims thun mong min pa'i sgyu ma dang gsum te don 'di gsum rgyud la bskor ba legs/ zhes pa ni/ dang po gnyis phal pa dang*/ phyi ma sgyu lus mtshan nyid par shes pa'i sgo nas dang po gnyis kyis rgyud smin byed byas pa la brten nas/ rdzogs rims pa'i sbas don gyi sgyu lus sgrub pa la brtson pa drag po gyis shig ces pa'i don yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa la lnga/ sgyu lus kyi lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ sgyu lus ldang ba'i gnas bstan pa/ rgyu lus kyi nyer len gyi rgyu bstan pa/ rgyu lus kyi ngo bo bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ro rkyang gi rlung gi rgyu ba chad kyang 'tshal te 'chad nas/ dbugs rlung la sna bug tu 'gro 'ongs med par rlung sems dbu mar thim pas na bde chen gyi sems dben mthar thug pas 'od gsal 'char la/ de lta bu'i 'od gsal gyi ye shes de rgyu lus kyi lhan cig byed rgyu yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems sems dben mthar thug pa'i 'od gsal gyi mkha' la zhugs/

byang sems dkar dmar 'bar 'dzag kyang dbu mar thim yang 'tshal ste dbu mar byang sems 'bar 'dzag byas pa las byung ba'i/ zag med kyi bde chen 'bar ba'i dus te sems dben mthar thug pa'i bde chen gyi 'od gsal 'gags pa'i rjes de ma thag tu sgyu lus bzhengs pa yin no/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag rlung bcu dang*/ nyis khri dang chig stong drug brgya yis/ rlung gi rgyu ba snying kha'i rtsa a ba dhū tī'i dbyings su thim nas/ dbu ma'i nang gi mi shig pa'i thig le kha sbyar gyi dbus nas rgyu lus ldang ba yin no/ ༈ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung nyis khri chig stong drug brgyar che ba'i rlung dang*/ byang sems thams cad snying kha'i mi shig pa la bsdus te thims pa las byung ba'i sems dben mthar thug gi dpe'i 'od gsal gyi ye shes kyi bzhon par gyur pa'i bar snyen cing phra ba'i rlung 'od zer lnga pas nyer len dang*/ sems dben mthar thug pa'i shin tu phra ba'i pa'i sems kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa las/ sgyu lus ldang ba yin no/ ༈ /lnga pa ni sems dben mthar thug pa'i 'od gsal gyi rlung sems gnyis kyi nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la rten nas phung po rnying pa las go sa logs su lha gzhal med khang dang bcas pa'i rten dang rten pa'i sgyu lus longs sku 'khor bcas sogs dngos gnas la 'grub par 'gyur zhing de'i tshe rje longs sku bla ma'i zhal lta ston/ zhes pa te rang lus lha'i skur mos pa tsam ma yin par rang gi shin tu phra ba'i rlung lus de/ sgyu lus longs spyod rdzogs pa lha'i skur dngos gnas la 'gyur zhing*/ sgyu lus longs sku thams cad kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong zhes pa'i don yin no// 'di dag gis pha ma'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang*/ rgya gzhung rnams na ches mi gsal zhing*/ sbas don gyi tshul du gnas pa'i sgyu lus gang las sgrub pa'i gzhi dang*/

de las sgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ sgrub pa'i sgyu lus kyi khyad chos rnams/ nā ro dang mar pa'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i zhal shes kyi man ngag la rten nas/ ches shin tu gsal bar bstan pas mkhas grub chen po rnams yid 'phrogs pa'i gsung khyad par can du snang ngo*/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gnyid dus kyi bsre ba gsum bshad pa dang*/ des sad dus dang*/ 'chi dus kyi bsre ba la mtshon te bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre ba/ rmi lam longs sku dang bsre ba/ sad pa sprul sku dang bsre ba'o// dang po ni/ gnyid dang rmi lam gnyis kyi bar zhig na/ sad dus su gtum mo sogs bsgom pa'i mthus rlung sna bug la 'gro 'ongs med par dbu mar thim pa'i mthus/ snying kha'i dbu ma'i nang gi pho brang na/ sems sgom pa rang bzhin gyis med par rtogs pa'i ye shes las/ stong pa bzhi shar ba'i dus su dga' ba bzhi bskyed de/ lhan skyes kyi bde chen gyi stong nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i gnyid kyi 'od gsal chos sku dang bsre ba'i nyams yang 'char ba yin zhing*/ ༈ gnyis pa ni/ 'od gsal de las langs ma thag rmi lam 'khrul pa'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ snang stong 'khrul pa'i rmi lam ngo shes par byas nas/ rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad bden pa'i skye med stong pa'i dbyings su thag sbad kyis bcad te/ stong nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa'i rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa dang*/ tha snyad du snang ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i sprul par 'char ba yang bslab 'tshal lo// spyir snang ba lha sku ru bsgyur ba dang*/ yang dgos rmi lam gyi dge sbyor gyi gtso bor shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi rmi lam gyi lus lha'i sku/ sgyu ma'i skur bsgom pa yin no// zhar byung sngar med gsar du sprul ba dang*/ sngar yod gzhan du bsgyur ba dang dag ma dag gi zhing khams lta ba'i rmi lam gyi dge sbyor rnams bskyangs par bya ba yin no// gsum pa ni/

sogs khongs nas rmi lam gyi longs sku phung po rnying pa la zhugs ste/ gnyid sad par byed pa sad pa sprul sku dang bsre ba bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ bsre ba rnam gsum gdams kyang 'tshal// zhes pas sad dus kyi bsre ba gsum dang*/ gnyid dus kyi bsre ba gsum dang*/ 'chi dus kyi bsre ba gsum gyi gdams ngag rnams nyams su len dgos par bstan no// 'di dag gis nā ro'i khyad chos shin tu gces pa'i gnas bsre ba skor dgu'i gnad phra zhib rnams gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ ༈ /bzhi pa ni/ sngar bshad pa/ 'di rnams rnal 'byor pa mi la ras pa nga'i nyams len mthar thug pa rnams glu ru blangs pa yin zhing gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi lam cha lag dang bcas pa gsal bar kha ru blangs pa yin la dga' drags pa'i mi rgan nga yi rgad mo yin// zhes pa ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ ras chung pa la thugs dgyes bzhin pa'i ngang nas gnang ba'i chos drug bsre ba dang bcas pa'i man ngag khyad par can 'di ni mi gzhan la med pa'i nā ro dang*/ mar pa'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin no// zhes pa'o// bkra shis shog// /
